In the following graph, the rectangle area shows the proportion of area occupied by each crop relative to the total cropped hectares included in CropMED.



Data validation
Overall, we found high correlation (\(R^2 = 0.094,\ \textrm{NRMSE}=0.0015\)) between data from CropMED administrative units aggregated at the country-level and those reported from FAOSTAT (https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/QCL). Here we show the validation for some of the most relevant crops included in CropMED, where countries with higher divergences are pointed out.

title: About
text:
Update Plan
The CropMED dataset is intended to be updated every two years by members of the Global Change Ecology and Evolution Research group (GLOCEE) from Universidad de Alcalá. This will be done by repeating the harmonization strategy to new data as they become available in their official websites.

title: Data Quality Indicators
text:
We assigned data quality scores to crop groups within each country across three dimensions: spatial (administrative level reached), temporal (updating periodicity of data) and taxonomic (number of unique crops reported for a crop group).

Our main goals:
Develop three-four questions or research areas constituting the core of MaCroPheST. Probably, the main objectives of the project.

title: About
text:
Research dimensions

Crops spatial distributions and yields
Pests spatial distributions
Crop and pest temporal distribution (phenology)
Experimental crop and pests responses to temperature: thermal tolerance and performance
Forecasts under climate warming scenarios.
Inference pest sharing events among crops: which new pests are likely to ocurr?
